en/prep_hard.1.calm.4.text: Get ready for the work. Loose grip, feet firm.

en/prep_hard.1.calm.5.text: A few easy strokes, then the work begins.

en/prep_hard.1.cox.0.text: Heads up, here it comes! Sit tall, eyes up!

en/prep_hard.1.cox.1.text: Get ready! Feet in, grip firm, head up!

en/prep_hard.1.cox.2.text: Work is coming! Breathe, focus in!

en/prep_hard.1.cox.3.text: Ready up! We start long and strong!

en/prep_hard.1.cox.4.text: Few more strokes, then we go! Focus!

en/prep_hard.1.cox.5.text: Wake up, work's coming! Stay calm, be ready!

en/prep_hard.1.motivating.0.text: Here it comes. Take a breath, you're ready.

en/prep_hard.1.motivating.1.text: Next hard piece is coming. You've done this many times.

en/prep_hard.1.motivating.2.text: This one's a challenge. Enjoy it, you're well prepared.

en/prep_hard.1.motivating.3.text: Almost time. Deep breath, firm grip, clear head.

en/prep_hard.1.motivating.4.text: Time to show what you've got. Get ready!

en/prep_hard.1.motivating.5.text: Gather yourself, we start in a moment. You've got this.

en/rate_high.1.motivating.2.text: Less rate, more power – that's it!

en/rate_high.2.calm.3.text: Rate back into the target range.

en/rate_high.2.motivating.1.text: Take your time – it costs nothing!

en/rate_high.2.motivating.2.text: Get calm, power does the work!

en/rate_high.2.motivating.4.text: Long strokes – they take you further!

en/rate_high.2.motivating.5.text: Calm it down, every stroke counts!

en/rate_low.1.calm.2.text: A bit quicker on the recovery.

en/rate_low.1.motivating.0.text: Rate up, you can do it!

en/rate_low.1.motivating.2.text: Come on, a bit more tempo!

en/rate_low.1.motivating.4.text: A bit livelier – that suits you!

en/rate_low.2.calm.3.text: Rate back into the target range.

en/rate_low.2.calm.4.text: Bring the rate up now, please.

en/rate_low.2.motivating.0.text: Come on, really lift that rate!

en/rate_low.2.motivating.2.text: Step on it now, more tempo!

en/rate_low.2.motivating.5.text: More tempo – you can do it!

en/rest_prepare.1.calm.0.text: Rest ends soon. Start to get ready.

en/rest_prepare.1.calm.1.text: Back to work shortly. Check your position.

en/rest_prepare.1.calm.2.text: A little more rest, then the next piece.

en/rest_prepare.1.calm.3.text: Get ready. Feet firm, loose grip.

en/rest_prepare.1.calm.4.text: Rest almost over. Pick up the rhythm.

en/rest_prepare.1.calm.5.text: Soon again. One more deep breath.

en/rest_prepare.1.cox.1.text: Wake up! Back to it soon!

en/rest_prepare.1.motivating.0.text: Back to it soon – you're recovered!

en/rest_prepare.1.motivating.2.text: Off again soon. Look forward to it!

en/rest_prepare.1.motivating.3.text: Back in a moment. Head up, you're doing great.

en/rest_prepare.1.motivating.4.text: A few more breaths, then show it again!

en/rest_prepare.1.motivating.5.text: Gather yourself – here we go soon!

en/rest_recover.1.calm.1.text: Recovery. Breathe deeply, relax your shoulders.

en/rest_recover.1.calm.2.text: Rest. Take a drink if you need.

en/rest_recover.1.calm.3.text: Easy now. Let the heart rate drop.

en/rest_recover.1.calm.5.text: Rest. Relax your hands and shoulders.

en/rest_recover.1.cox.2.text: Light pressure! Drink if you need!

en/rest_recover.1.cox.4.text: Paddle! Bring the heart rate down!

en/rest_recover.1.motivating.0.text: Well done! Now breathe and recover.

en/rest_recover.1.motivating.1.text: Rest earned! Stay loose, have a drink.

en/rest_recover.1.motivating.2.text: Nice! Get your breath back, you were strong.

en/rest_too_hard.1.calm.0.text: This is rest. Row easy, please.

en/rest_too_hard.1.calm.1.text: Too much pressure for recovery. Ease off.

en/rest_too_hard.1.calm.2.text: Use the rest, row very lightly.

en/rest_too_hard.1.calm.4.text: Easy now, the next piece is coming.

en/rest_too_hard.1.calm.5.text: Reduce pressure, let the heart rate drop.

en/rest_too_hard.1.motivating.1.text: Nice and easy – recovery makes you stronger!

en/rest_too_hard.1.motivating.2.text: Save it for the next interval!

en/rest_too_hard.1.motivating.4.text: Let go, you'll need that energy soon!

en/slower_than_prev.1.calm.0.text: A bit slower than the previous interval.

en/slower_than_prev.1.calm.1.text: Pace dropped slightly. Pace the next one fresh.

en/slower_than_prev.1.calm.2.text: Slower than before. Recover, then go again.

en/slower_than_prev.1.calm.3.text: Slight loss of pace. Start the next one evenly.

en/slower_than_prev.1.calm.4.text: A bit slower. Use the rest well.

en/slower_than_prev.1.calm.5.text: Below the last pace. Start a bit calmer next time.

en/slower_than_prev.1.cox.0.text: A touch slower! We take the next!

en/slower_than_prev.1.cox.1.text: Let it go! Next one's stronger!

en/slower_than_prev.1.cox.5.text: Use the rest! Then full again!

en/slower_than_prev.1.motivating.0.text: A bit slower – you'll get the next one!

en/slower_than_prev.1.motivating.1.text: No problem, recover, then attack again!

en/slower_than_prev.1.motivating.2.text: The next one will be stronger!

en/slower_than_prev.1.motivating.3.text: Breathe, you'll show it again next time!

en/slower_than_prev.1.motivating.4.text: Good fight – you'll get it next time!

en/slower_than_prev.1.motivating.5.text: Use the rest, you've got reserves!

en/stopped.1.calm.1.text: Carry on, pick it up calmly.

en/stopped.1.cox.4.text: Go on! We're still in it!

en/stopped.1.motivating.2.text: You can do it, keep going!

en/stopped.1.motivating.3.text: Just start again, you've got this!

en/stopped.2.calm.1.text: The piece is still running. Please start again.

en/stopped.2.calm.2.text: Pick it up, easy is better than nothing.

en/stopped.2.calm.3.text: Keep rowing, light pressure if needed.

en/stopped.2.motivating.0.text: Come on, back in – you can!

en/stopped.2.motivating.1.text: One stroke at a time, go!

en/stopped.2.motivating.3.text: You were going so well – on!

en/stopped.2.motivating.4.text: Come on, let's finish this together!

en/stopped.2.motivating.6.text: Go, every stroke gets you closer!

en/strong_finish.1.motivating.9.text: You saved the best for last!

en/technique.1.calm.4.text: Hands away first, then the body.

en/technique.1.calm.7.text: Push with the legs, then pull.

en/technique.1.calm.9.text: Breathe in rhythm with the strokes.

en/technique.1.motivating.0.text: Get nice and long – feels good!

en/technique.1.motivating.2.text: Legs first – that's where your power is!

en/technique.1.motivating.5.text: Light grip, power comes from the legs!

en/technique.1.motivating.6.text: A nice, round stroke – just like that!

en/workout_done.1.calm.1.text: Session finished. Now paddle it out.

en/workout_done.1.calm.3.text: Done. Remember to cool down and stretch.

en/workout_done.1.calm.7.text: Workout over. Have a drink, stay loose.

en/workout_done.1.cox.4.text: Easy! You fought to the end!

en/workout_done.1.cox.5.text: Done! That was locked in today!

en/workout_done.1.cox.8.text: Easy! You can build on that!

en/workout_done.1.motivating.1.text: Great! You pulled through the whole session!

en/workout_done.1.motivating.3.text: Well done! Be proud of yourself.

en/workout_done.1.motivating.4.text: Finished! That was really good work.

en/workout_done.1.motivating.5.text: Great session, you were strong today!

en/workout_done.1.motivating.6.text: Done – every stroke was worth it!

en/workout_final.1.calm.3.text: Last stretch. Row it out evenly.

en/workout_final.1.motivating.0.text: Final stretch of the session – almost done!

en/workout_final.1.motivating.4.text: Final phase! You were great today.

en/workout_final.1.motivating.5.text: The end is near – enjoy it!

en/workout_final.1.motivating.9.text: Nearly at the finish! Keep it up!

en/workout_half.1.cox.1.text: Half the session! Stay on it!

en/workout_half.1.motivating.2.text: Half the session, you're doing great!

en/workout_half.1.motivating.3.text: Halfway! You're well on your way!

en/workout_half.1.motivating.6.text: Half done, you're in good shape!

en/workout_half.1.motivating.8.text: Halfway! Now own the second half!
